column3: “Visions of his head” is rendered “visions in his mind”; “the head of the matters he said” is rendered “related the following summary of it.”
“Was replying and saying” is shortened to “said.”
Close to the Aramaic.
“I was seeing” is rendered “I kept looking,” “earth” “ground,” and “a heart of a human” “a human mind.”
“Flesh” is rendered “meat”; NASB adds “one” after “second.”
“I was seeing” is rendered “I kept looking.”
“Fearful and terrible” is rendered “dreadful and terrifying”; “I was seeing” is rendered “I kept looking.”
“Were uprooted” is rendered “were pulled out by the roots,” and “great things” “great boasts.”
“One ancient of days” is rendered as a title, “the Ancient of Days,” and “his throne was flames of fire” “His throne was ablaze with flames.”
“Ministering” is rendered “attending.”
“Great words” is rendered “boastful words”; “the burning of fire” is rendered “the burning fire.”
“They removed” is rendered with a passive; “until a time and a time” is rendered “for an appointed period of time.”
“A son of man” is capitalized “a Son of Man”; “they brought him near” is rendered “was presented.”
“Honor” is rendered “Glory,” and “pay reverence” “serve”; “languages” is rendered “men of every language.”
“In the midst of the sheath” (body) is rendered “within me.”
“The truth” is rendered “the exact meaning”; NASB adds “began.”
NASB adds “in number” and “are.”
“Holy ones” is rendered “saints,” and “Most High” (plural form) “Highest One”; “until perpetuity of perpetuities” is rendered “for all ages to come.”
“To make certain” is rendered “to know the exact meaning.”
NASB adds “the meaning of” and “namely”; “companion” is rendered “associates.”
“Holy ones” is rendered “saints,” and “prevailing” “overpowering.”
“Judgment was given for” is rendered “judgment was passed in favor of”; “holy ones” is rendered “saints.”
NASB adds “other.”
“Bring low” is rendered “subdue.”
“To the side of” is rendered “out against,” and “wear out” “wear down”; “Most High” (plural form) is rendered “Highest One.”
NASB adds “for judgment”; “until the end” is rendered “forever.”
“Kingdom” is rendered “sovereignty,” and “a people, the holy ones” “the people of the saints.”

“To here the end of the matter” is rendered “At this point the revelation ended”; “my brightness was changed” is rendered “my face grew pale.” Close to the Aramaic otherwise; the Hebrew resumes in 8:1.
